purpose: identify whether uncertainty-aware public planning improves the decision-relevant urgent-opposite profile without future-truth leakage

arms.robust: equal public counterfactual ensemble over announced and opposite sectors
arms.masked: same public-plan architecture with forecast-sector identity removed

primary_endpoint: urgent_opposite weighted service value and future completion, reported jointly with primary completion and energy
decision_rule: Expand only if robust exceeds both direct and masked on the primary endpoint in at least two of three training seeds without erasing primary service reliability.
interpretation_boundary: Development pilot. Counterfactual sectors are public hypotheses, never the hidden future request realization.
